texto.es: Nos cuentas sobre tu perro o gato, el pelaje, el tamaño, peluquería o guardería, y te orientamos de inmediato.

items.quote: We've officially found our go-to groomer! Mary did an incredible job with our pup. Despite him arriving with a heavily matted coat, she worked her magic and he came out looking handsome, happy, and refreshed. She was professional, accommodating, and clearly has a way with animals. We'll definitely be back!
Mary is amazing! She trims my dogs nails perfectly and always takes the extra time to brush him so he leaves soft and happy. Since she works out of her home, it’s calm and stress-free.
I couldn't be happier with my experience at Woof Pack Grooming! From the moment we walked in, the friendly and knowledgeable staff made both me and my pup feel welcome.
